criteria.requirement: Add Machine.dispatch_report(trigger,*args,collect_errors=True,**kwargs) for nonqueued synchronous machines. Snapshot model declaration order, call actual bound trigger once each, return ordered tuple rows with ordinal/model identity/source/dest/result/status/error_type. False is rejected, True succeeded, exception failed without leaking error message. Collect mode continues, fail-fast stops after error row; prior successful states are not rolled back. Reject queued and async triggers before execution rather than call admission True final success. Existing dispatch bool unchanged.
